description: Diagnose a selector that already exists — from a test file, a failing test, or a pull request — against the open page. When a test fails on a locator, call this FIRST, before re-identifying the element. It says whether the locator is broken (matches nothing), ambiguous (matches several), fragile, or healthy. If it reports Healthy, STOP: the locator is not why the test failed — look at the product or the assertion instead of replacing it. Accepts a CSS selector, an XPath, page.getByRole/getByText/getByLabel/getByPlaceholder/getByTestId/getByAltText/getByTitle(…) or page.locator('…') — chained with .locator/.getBy*/.filter({ has, hasNot, hasText, hasNotText, visible })/.or()/.and()/.first()/.last()/.nth(n) — cy.get('…') or cy.contains(…), chained with .find/.filter/.not/.closest/.parent/.children/.contains/.eq/.first/.last — $('…') / $$('…') with a WebdriverIO selector (CSS, XPath, tag=text, tag.class=text, *=text), chained with .$/.$$/[n]/.parentElement() and .filter/.find((el) => el.isDisplayed() | (await el.getText()) === … | (await el.$(…).isExisting())).

framework.description: Framework to render alternatives for. Default: the framework of the project as cor_open reported it, else the form of the selector (getBy* → playwright, cy.* → cypress), else playwright.

param.description: For a parameterised helper: the variable in the selector (e.g. title in getByText(title, { exact: true })). COR runs the locator for every value and says which items no value reaches.

selector.description: The selector exactly as written in the test, e.g. page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Save' }) or cy.get('.btn').

values.description: Values to run the parameterised locator with. Omit to let COR find each item's values on the page (needs the chain to start with page.locator('css')).

name: cor_grade
title: Grade an existing selector
